title: The Old Lighthouse
desc: 暴风雨之夜，一束光和一个彻夜未眠的人。

vocab.en: a tall tower with a light to guide ships
vocab.ex: An old lighthouse stood alone against the sea.
vocab.exZh: 一座古老的灯塔独自矗立在海边。

vocab.en: a person who looks after a place
vocab.ex: Every night, its keeper climbed the narrow stairs.
vocab.exZh: 每天夜里，看守人都会爬上狭窄的楼梯。

vocab.ex: The beam of light moved slowly across the dark water.
vocab.exZh: 光束缓缓扫过黑暗的水面。

en: On a small island far from the town, an old lighthouse stood alone against the sea.
Every night, its keeper climbed the narrow stairs and lit the great lamp at the top.
The beam of light moved slowly across the dark water, warning ships away from the rocks.
zh: 在远离城镇的一座小岛上，一座古老的灯塔独自矗立在海边。
每天夜里，看守人都会爬上狭窄的楼梯，点亮顶端的大灯。
光束缓缓扫过黑暗的水面，提醒船只远离礁石。

en: One winter night, a terrible storm came, and the wind shook the whole tower.
The keeper stayed at his post, although he was cold, tired, and very lonely.
He knew that if the light went out, the ships would have no one to guide them home.
zh: 一个冬夜，一场可怕的暴风雨来了，狂风摇撼着整座塔。
看守人坚守在岗位上，尽管他又冷又累，非常孤独。
他知道，如果灯灭了，船只就没有人引导它们回家了。

en: At dawn, the storm passed, and three ships were safe in the harbour, thanks to that one small light.
The keeper never told anyone what he had done that night.
But every sailor who saw the lighthouse knew that someone had stayed awake for them.
zh: 黎明时分，暴风雨过去了，三艘船安全地停在港口，多亏了那一小束光。
看守人从未向任何人提起那晚他所做的事。
但每一个看到灯塔的水手都知道，有人为他们彻夜未眠。
